description: An action the user takes: submit a form, open a dialog, run a command. Renders a real <button>; variant="default" is the primary style and variant="destructive" marks an irreversible action. It does not navigate: for a link to another page use <a href>.

loading.description: Shows loading state and disables interaction

type.description: Form behaviour, forwarded to the native <button> this component renders. submit submits the owning form (running native constraint validation first); reset resets it. Defaults to button, which does neither.

name.description: Submitter name included with form data.

value.description: Submitter value included with form data.

form.description: Id of an external form that owns the button.

formaction.description: Submit URL override for submit buttons.

formmethod.description: HTTP method override for submit buttons.

formnovalidate.description: Skips form validation when this submit button is used.

formtarget.description: Browsing context target for the form response.

command.description: Invoker command sent to the element named by commandfor when the button is activated, e.g. command="--open" to open an aihio-dialog. Aihio components take --prefixed custom commands; see each component's commands.

commandfor.description: Id of the element that receives command. Use with command to open or close an overlay without script.

click.description: Fired when the button is clicked

handled: The component renders a real <button> and forwards its attributes to it, so the role, Enter and Space activation, focus behaviour, disabled semantics, and the forced-colours mapping are the platform's rather than an emulation of it
aria-* set on the host is mirrored onto that control
aria-busy reflects loading state, which also disables the control
Form participation is native: the button is a submitter of its owning form, so Enter in a field submits, SubmitEvent.submitter identifies it, and <fieldset disabled> disables it in both directions
type="submit" runs native constraint validation before the form submits

required.when: size="icon" or the button has no visible text
required.requirement: Provide aria-label describing the action (e.g. aria-label="Close").
Set type="submit" and either place the button inside its <form> or reference that form with the form attribute.

counterExamples.reason: variant="primary" is not valid. The primary style is variant="default".
Buttons must not be nested. Use sibling buttons or aihio-dropdown for grouped actions.
Icon-only button is missing an accessible name. Add aria-label="Close" (or similar).
A submit button outside the <form> never submits it. Move the button inside the form element.

examples:
<form>
  <label>
    Email
    <aihio-input type="email" name="email" required></aihio-input>
  </label>
  <aihio-button type="submit">Sign in</aihio-button>
</form>

<aihio-button commandfor="confirm-delete" command="--open" variant="destructive">Delete project</aihio-button>

<aihio-dialog id="confirm-delete">
  <aihio-dialog-header>
    <aihio-dialog-title>Delete project?</aihio-dialog-title>
  </aihio-dialog-header>
  <form method="post">
    <aihio-dialog-footer>
      <aihio-button commandfor="confirm-delete" command="--close" variant="outline">Cancel</aihio-button>
      <aihio-button type="submit" variant="destructive">Delete project</aihio-button>
    </aihio-dialog-footer>
  </form>
</aihio-dialog>

control.description: The native button delegated to by the component

form.description: The owning form, or null outside one

focus().description: Moves focus to the native button.

blur().description: Removes focus from the native button.
